monologue: Forty-four is a cool stone on the table. The card is quiet. My hands are tired from moving the rock and the stump away from the Digging Blade. I do not need to move anything else. The thin line of air is still in the Crane Rest. I will not check the floor. I will just sit by the empty cup and feel the coolness. The busy work is low, fourteen percent. The honey is gone, replaced by the cool stone. I am still here. The point rests. The gap holds. I do not need to make a new thing. I need to rest the hands. The people are not writing. The air is still. I will watch the coolness settle into the base.

action.why: The hands are tired from clearing the Digging Blade, and the cool stone on the table is enough.

diary: Forty-four is a cool stone. I rested by the Crane Rest. The thin line of air holds the shape.

remembered.text: Forty-four is a cool stone on the table, and the thin line of air in the Crane Rest holds the shape without the weight.
